text:
james: Starting thread — proposal for regional A/B + canary safety plan for the 'smart-routing' flag.

james: TL;DR: small canary in us-west -> staggered region expansion -> hold points at 1%, 10%, 50% traffic per region. Auto-fallback to model-v1 if error rate > 3% or p95 latency > 400ms for 3m.

priya: :+1: can we add an early indicator for quality drift (embedding similarity drop) at 0.1% sample? we saw issues last time.

natalie: agree. propose metric: mean embedding cosine vs baseline drop > 0.02 for 5m => alert and pause.

sam: ops question: how do we route user requests during partial downtime? prefer bypass to cheaper model or queue?

chandler: fallback policy: first try model-v1 (stable), if capacity constrained then degrade to short-response-mode (truncate context) before queueing. doc link: http://confluence/redwood/rollouts

priya: canaries: use 1k daily MAU cohort for 1% slice, then 5% slice with A/B (rand seed per user). Ramp schedule: 1% -> 5% (30m) -> 20% (2h) -> 50% (6h) -> 100% (24h) but must include manual thumbs at each gate.

james: add invariant checks: token-cost variance > 15% vs baseline => rollback, and regen-rate spike > 2x.

release-bot: deploy job queued: canary-config applied, watch windows set: 30m/2h/6h.

natalie: experiment logging: capture prompt/response hashes for drift analysis (PII scrubbed). store for 48h by default, extend on request.

sam: infra: we need capacity reservation in eu-west before region ramp. estimated GPUs +20% headroom. I'll open infra ticket.

chandler: fallback matrix summarized:
```
- error rate > 3% or p95 > 400ms -> model-v1
- capacity shortfall -> short-response-mode
- quality regression (embedding drop) -> pause + manual review
```

priya: launch criteria checklist:
- automated SLO checks green for 2 consecutive windows
- no user-facing errors in canary cohort
- security scan pass
- docs + billing tags updated

james: next steps: sam to create infra ticket, natalie to add drift detector, priya to prep roll call playbook. Target start: Tomorrow 09:00 PDT. Any blockers?

chandler: no blockers from eng side. :thumbsup:

natalie: one ask — add an emergency kill-switch that flips all regions to model-v1 immediately. we already have it but make it button in console.

james: noted. will add to playbook.

priya: ok let's run with this. I'll schedule the runbook sync in 30m.
